segments.name: Composite Materials
products: HexForce® fabrics, multi-axials and specialty reinforcements
segments.description: Manufactures and markets carbon fibers, reinforcements, prepregs, adhesives, honeycomb and pultruded profiles for commercial and military aircraft, transportation and industrial applications.
segments.evidence: The Composite Materials segment is comprised of our carbon fiber, specialty reinforcements, resin systems, prepregs and other fiber-reinforced matrix materials, and honeycomb core product lines and pultruded profiles.

segments.name: Engineered Products
segments.description: Manufactures composite structures and precision machined honeycomb parts, plus RF/EMI and microwave absorbing materials, primarily for the aerospace industry.
segments.evidence: The Engineered Products segment is comprised of lightweight high strength composite structures, radio frequency/electromagnetic interference ("RF/EMI") and microwave absorbing materials, engineered core and specialty machined honeycomb products with added functionality.

revenueModel.text: Hexcel earns net sales from third-party customers, primarily aerospace manufacturers, who buy its advanced composite materials and engineered products.
revenueModel.evidence: Net sales for the Composite Materials segment to third-party customers were $1,516.2 million in 2025, $1,531.0 million in 2024, and $1,474.2 million in 2023, which represented about 80% of our net sales each year.

changes.text: In 2025, Hexcel completed the divestiture of its operations in Austria, which only served industrial markets with industrial-grade fibers procured from third parties.
changes.evidence: During the third quarter of 2025, the Company completed the divestiture of its operations in Austria.

changes.text: Beginning with the first quarter of 2025, Hexcel began reporting sales for a new market category, Defense, Space & Other, combining the previous Space & Defense and Industrial markets.
changes.evidence: Beginning with the first quarter of 2025, sales are being reported for two markets, Commercial Aerospace, unchanged from past practice, and a new sales category titled Defense, Space & Other, which combines the previous Space & Defense market and the Industrial market.
